Question:
Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? No politicans are part of the Nazi Reichstag.
Premises:
HeinrichScmidt(NaziGermanPolitician) ∧ MemberOfParliament(HeinrichScmidt, PrussianStateParliament) ∧ MemberOfParliament(HeinrichScmidt, NaziReichstag) ::: Heinrich Scmidt was a Nazi German politician and a member of both the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Nazi(x) ∧ MemberOfParliament(x, NaziReichstag)) ::: No politicians are part of the Nazi Reichstag.
